_comment: Every Mermaid flowchart and sequence diagram under docs/ is converted at build time (flowcharts to React Flow, sequences to inline SVG). exclude: diagrams that stay on Mermaid, with the reason. diagrams: per-diagram extras. scenarios = a link-failure toggle (fail = links that go down, idle = links that carry nothing while down, reroute = backup links that take the traffic, note = what the reader sees). packetWalk = one packet walks a sequence diagram's messages. Packets themselves run on edges marked `e1@{ animate: true }` in the Mermaid source. index = position among the page's ```mermaid blocks; an entry that matches no block fails the build.

exclude.why: ELK puts each subgraph in its own band: 2.5x taller than Mermaid, one edge spans the diagram

scenarios.label: Fail NIC port 8
scenarios.note: Port 8 down: plane 8 goes dark and packets keep spraying over the other planes. The node loses one port's bandwidth (≈12%), the job keeps running.

scenarios.label: Fail link S–N
scenarios.note: S–N down: S (the PLR) repairs at once onto the post-convergence path S→A→B→C→D, adding RL = ⟨Node-SID(B), Adj-SID(B→C)⟩. No wait for IGP convergence.
